description: Reads the whole funnel of a webinar: visitors, registrations, live attendance, watched enough, offer shown, offer clicked, replay, purchased, with the rate from step to step. It also ranks the host's webinars and names the one step to fix first. Take it when a host asks where people drop off, for example "Where do I lose them?" It needs the session id and reads only from the connected site, changing nothing. Rates need at least 20 people in the earlier step, otherwise the answer says not enough data. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step. Words hosts use: funnel, conversion, drop off, where do I lose them, webinar numbers

all.description: true compares all webinars and ranks them by volume.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

utm.description: Filter the whole funnel by one UTM value, e.g. a source such as facebook.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out to rank all webinars of the host.

name: wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats
title: Read the webinar funnel and what to improve
